allowed_sequential_loops.reason: AR(1) recursion for the persistent alpha signal depends on t-1 state; inherently sequential, bounded by N_DAYS
agent action loop: each step depends on the previous observation; plus the same 7-step plan replayed once for the determinism check

agent_thought_process.initial_analysis: The task is not 'screen a factor' but 'conduct the screening THROUGH an environment' whose precondition chain encodes the methodology: compute raw factor values before neutralizing, neutralize market/sector exposures before measuring the information coefficient, measure IC before assessing tradeability via turnover. The chain's critical link is the IC guard: a raw factor contaminated by beta and sector tilts produces an IC that mixes stock-selection skill with benchmark exposure — up-market days inflate it, down-market days deflate it — so the environment must REFUSE the premature IC request with an error observation naming benchmark contamination, and the scripted plan's two deliberate ordering mistakes exist to train exactly that read-the-error-and-re-plan loop. A second lesson rides along: neutralization is verifiable (residual beta correlation ~0) and it IMPROVES the IC t-stat, because removing exposure noise shrinks the IC series' variance.
agent_thought_process.tool_selection: Python REPL hosting the environment; numpy for the panel simulation, the constant hat-matrix exposure projection, and fully vectorized rank-IC computation (double-argsort ranks plus row-wise Pearson); json for the observation protocol — every observation must survive a json round-trip because RLM agents consume serialized tool output, never live objects.
agent_thought_process.recursive_delegation: Depth 3 covers parent -> screening sub-agent -> verification sub-agent replaying the trace against a fresh same-seed environment. The parent owns the screening plan; the sub-agent drives actions and must surface, not suppress, error observations; the verifier's replay is performed inline here as the deterministic_replay invariant.

research_corpus.hypothesis_formulation: Environment-level hypotheses — H0-env: the environment is NOT a faithful instrument (permits IC computation on a contaminated factor, emits non-serializable observations, fails to neutralize exposures, reports an IC indistinguishable from noise, or replays non-deterministically). H1-env: all nine checks hold — both unordered actions rejected, the IC guard emitting the exact benchmark-contamination error, full action sequence recovered, json round-trip, residual beta correlation ~0 after neutralization, neutralized mean rank IC > 0.01, neutralized IC t-stat exceeding the raw factor's, top-quintile daily turnover in the tradeable range (0, 0.5), and exact deterministic replay. Verdict ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED is the conjunction; any failure yields ENVIRONMENT_BROKEN.
research_corpus.data_engineering: Data are generated INSIDE the environment on reset(): 300 assets x 252 days, 10 sectors, betas U(0.5, 1.5); returns load on market factor (16% ann), sector shocks (8% ann), idiosyncratic noise (25% ann), and a REAL but modest alpha: an AR(1) signal (phi=0.95) whose lagged value enters next-day returns scaled to a true daily cross-sectional IC of ~0.04 — so screening has something genuine to find. The raw factor is that signal contaminated with 0.6x market beta and 0.5x per-sector bias, making the pre-neutralization factor visibly exposure-loaded (mean-factor/beta correlation ~0.37 in the observation). The exposure matrix [1, beta, sector dummies] is constant, so a single precomputed hat-matrix projection neutralizes every day vectorized.
research_corpus.methodology_justification: Rank IC (factor at t vs return at t+1) is the standard screening statistic because it is monotone-invariant and robust to outliers; computing it against NEXT-day returns bakes no-same-day-peeking into the environment rather than trusting the agent. Cross-sectional regression residualization against [1, beta, sector dummies] is the textbook neutralization; because exposures are constant, the projection is one matrix product per panel — the vectorization lesson. Guards return error observations rather than raising because observation-driven re-planning, not crash handling, is the trainable RLM behavior; the IC guard's error string names the METHODOLOGICAL reason (benchmark contamination), teaching the agent why the ordering exists, not merely that it does. Turnover is measured as the daily exit rate of the top quintile — the implementability statistic that separates a paper factor from a tradeable one.
research_corpus.code_implementation:
"""RLM TEACHING ENTRY: cross-sectional factor screening as ENVIRONMENT
INTERACTION, with strict precondition chains and error-driven re-planning.

The screening workflow is exposed as a stateful environment with a
gym-like reset/step API and a strict precondition chain:

  reset -> compute_factor_values -> neutralize_exposures
        -> compute_information_coefficient -> evaluate_turnover

The chain encodes real methodology: a raw factor contaminated by market
beta and sector tilts produces an IC that mixes signal with benchmark
exposure — so the environment REFUSES to compute the IC before
neutralization, returning an error observation (never an exception) that
the agent must read and re-plan from. The scripted plan contains TWO
deliberate ordering mistakes to train exactly that refusal-and-recovery
loop. All observations are JSON-serializable dicts; deterministic replay
is verified against a fresh same-seed environment. Seeded throughout.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import numpy as np

RNG_SEED = 14
N_ASSETS = 300
N_DAYS = 252
N_SECTORS = 10
ANN = 252
SIGNAL_PHI = 0.95            # AR(1) persistence of the true alpha signal
IC_STRENGTH = 0.05           # cross-sectional corr of signal with next-day idio return
BETA_CONTAM = 0.60           # market-beta contamination of the raw factor
SECTOR_CONTAM = 0.50         # sector-tilt contamination of the raw factor
MKT_VOL = 0.16 / np.sqrt(ANN)
SECTOR_VOL = 0.08 / np.sqrt(ANN)
IDIO_VOL = 0.25 / np.sqrt(ANN)
TOP_Q = 0.2                  # quintile used for the turnover metric

IC_GUARD_ERROR = ("must neutralize market/sector exposures before computing "
                  "IC to avoid benchmark contamination")


def _ranks(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Row-wise fractional ranks in [0, 1], fully vectorized (double argsort)."""
    order = np.argsort(x, axis=1)
    ranks = np.empty_like(order)
    np.put_along_axis(ranks, order, np.arange(x.shape[1])[None, :], axis=1)
    return ranks / (x.shape[1] - 1.0)


def _row_corr(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Row-wise Pearson correlation of two (days x assets) panels."""
    ad = a - a.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    bd = b - b.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    num = (ad * bd).sum(axis=1)
    den = np.sqrt((ad ** 2).sum(axis=1) * (bd ** 2).sum(axis=1))
    return num / den


class QuantEnvironment:
    """Stateful factor-screening environment.

    Guards return {"ok": False, "error": ...} observations for invalid
    orderings — the agent must read observations and re-plan, not crash.
    """

    ACTIONS = ("reset", "compute_factor_values", "neutralize_exposures",
               "compute_information_coefficient", "evaluate_turnover")

    def __init__(self, seed: int = RNG_SEED):
        self._seed = seed
        self._state = "uninitialized"
        self._rets = None
        self._factor_raw = None
        self._factor_neut = None
        self._proj = None
        self._betas = None
        self._ic_series = None

    def reset(self) -> dict:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(self._seed)
        betas = rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5, N_ASSETS)
        sectors = rng.integers(0, N_SECTORS, N_ASSETS)
        # Persistent true alpha signal (AR(1) across days, iid across assets).
        shocks = rng.standard_normal((N_DAYS, N_ASSETS))
        signal = np.zeros((N_DAYS, N_ASSETS))
        signal[0] = shocks[0]
        for t in range(1, N_DAYS):     # AR(1) recursion: inherently sequential
            signal[t] = (SIGNAL_PHI * signal[t - 1]
                         + np.sqrt(1.0 - SIGNAL_PHI ** 2) * shocks[t])
        f = MKT_VOL * rng.standard_normal(N_DAYS)
        g = SECTOR_VOL * rng.standard_normal((N_DAYS, N_SECTORS))
        eps = IDIO_VOL * rng.standard_normal((N_DAYS, N_ASSETS))
        # r_{t} loads on signal_{t-1}: the alpha is REAL but modest.
        lagged = np.vstack([np.zeros((1, N_ASSETS)), signal[:-1]])
        rets = (betas[None, :] * f[:, None] + g[:, sectors]
                + IDIO_VOL * IC_STRENGTH * lagged + eps)
        # Raw factor contaminated by exposures — the screening trap.
        sector_bias = rng.standard_normal(N_SECTORS)
        raw = (signal + BETA_CONTAM * betas[None, :]
               + SECTOR_CONTAM * sector_bias[sectors][None, :])
        # Constant exposure matrix -> one hat matrix serves every day.
        X = np.column_stack([np.ones(N_ASSETS), betas,
                             np.eye(N_SECTORS)[sectors][:, :-1]])
        self._proj = np.eye(N_ASSETS) - X @ np.linalg.pinv(X)
        self._rets, self._factor_raw, self._betas = rets, raw, betas
        self._factor_neut, self._ic_series = None, None
        self._state = "reset"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state, "n_assets": N_ASSETS,
                "n_days": N_DAYS, "n_sectors": N_SECTORS,
                "factor_ready": False}

    def step(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        name = action.get("name")
        if name not in self.ACTIONS:
            return {"ok": False, "error": f"unknown action: {name}",
                    "state": self._state}
        if name == "reset":
            return self.reset()
        if self._state == "uninitialized":
            return {"ok": False, "error": "call reset first",
                    "state": self._state}
        return getattr(self, f"_do_{name}")(action)

    def _do_compute_factor_values(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        corr_beta = float(np.corrcoef(self._factor_raw.mean(axis=0),
                                      self._betas)[0, 1])
        self._state = "factor_computed"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "coverage": 1.0,
                "raw_factor_beta_corr": round(corr_beta, 4),
                "contaminated": bool(abs(corr_beta) > 0.10)}

    def _do_neutralize_exposures(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._state not in ("factor_computed", "neutralized",
                               "ic_computed", "evaluated"):
            return {"ok": False,
                    "error": "compute_factor_values before neutralize_exposures",
                    "state": self._state}
        self._factor_neut = self._factor_raw @ self._proj.T
        corr_beta = float(np.corrcoef(self._factor_neut.mean(axis=0),
                                      self._betas)[0, 1])
        self._state = "neutralized"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "residual_beta_corr": round(corr_beta, 6),
                "neutralization_complete": bool(abs(corr_beta) < 1e-6)}

    def _do_compute_information_coefficient(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._factor_neut is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": IC_GUARD_ERROR, "state": self._state}
        # Daily rank IC: factor at t vs return at t+1 (no same-day peeking).
        fr = _ranks(self._factor_neut[:-1])
        rr = _ranks(self._rets[1:])
        self._ic_series = _row_corr(fr, rr)
        mean_ic = float(self._ic_series.mean())
        std_ic = float(self._ic_series.std(ddof=1))
        t_stat = mean_ic / std_ic * np.sqrt(self._ic_series.size)
        # Contaminated comparison, computed the identical way.
        ic_raw = _row_corr(_ranks(self._factor_raw[:-1]), rr)
        t_raw = float(ic_raw.mean() / ic_raw.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ic_raw.size))
        self._state = "ic_computed"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "mean_rank_ic": round(mean_ic, 4),
                "ic_t_stat": round(float(t_stat), 2),
                "raw_factor_ic_t_stat": round(t_raw, 2),
                "n_ic_days": int(self._ic_series.size)}

    def _do_evaluate_turnover(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._ic_series is None:
            return {"ok": False,
                    "error": "compute_information_coefficient before evaluate_turnover",
                    "state": self._state}
        r = _ranks(self._factor_neut)
        top = r > (1.0 - TOP_Q)
        exits = (top[:-1] & ~top[1:]).sum(axis=1)
        turnover = float(exits.mean() / top[0].sum())
        autocorr = float(_row_corr(r[:-1], r[1:]).mean())
        self._state = "evaluated"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "top_quintile_daily_turnover": round(turnover, 4),
                "signal_rank_autocorr": round(autocorr, 4),
                "tradeable": bool(turnover < 0.5)}


def main() -> None:
    env = QuantEnvironment(seed=RNG_SEED)
    # Scripted plan with TWO deliberate ordering mistakes.
    plan = [
        {"name": "compute_factor_values"},              # invalid: no reset yet
        {"name": "reset"},
        {"name": "compute_factor_values"},
        {"name": "compute_information_coefficient"},    # invalid: not neutralized
        {"name": "neutralize_exposures"},
        {"name": "compute_information_coefficient"},
        {"name": "evaluate_turnover"},
    ]
    executed, guard_failures, guard_errors = [], 0, []
    obs = None
    by_action = {}
    for action in plan:
        obs = env.step(action)
        print(f"trace={json.dumps({'action': action['name'], 'observation': obs}, sort_keys=True)}")
        if obs["ok"]:
            executed.append(action["name"])
            by_action[action["name"]] = obs
        else:
            guard_failures += 1
            guard_errors.append(obs["error"])

    ic_obs = by_action["compute_information_coefficient"]
    to_obs = by_action["evaluate_turnover"]
    checks = {
        "guards_rejected_both_unordered_actions": guard_failures == 2,
        "ic_guard_names_benchmark_contamination": IC_GUARD_ERROR in guard_errors,
        "recovered_full_action_sequence":
            executed == list(QuantEnvironment.ACTIONS),
        "final_observation_json_roundtrip": json.loads(json.dumps(obs)) == obs,
        "neutralization_kills_beta_exposure":
            by_action["neutralize_exposures"]["neutralization_complete"],
        "neutralized_ic_positive": ic_obs["mean_rank_ic"] > 0.01,
        "neutralized_t_stat_beats_raw":
            ic_obs["ic_t_stat"] > ic_obs["raw_factor_ic_t_stat"],
        "turnover_in_tradeable_range":
            0.0 < to_obs["top_quintile_daily_turnover"] < 0.5,
    }
    env2 = QuantEnvironment(seed=RNG_SEED)
    obs2 = None
    for action in plan:
        obs2 = env2.step(action)
    checks["deterministic_replay"] = obs == obs2

    print("RESULTS")
    print("environment_class=QuantEnvironment")
    print(f"actions_executed={','.join(executed)}")
    print(f"guard_failures_handled={guard_failures}")
    for name, passed in checks.items():
        print(f"check_{name}={passed}")
    print(f"final_observation={json.dumps(obs, sort_keys=True)}")
    verdict = "ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED" if all(checks.values()) else "ENVIRONMENT_BROKEN"
    print(f"verdict={verdict}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
research_corpus.statistical_validation: Nine machine-checked invariants printed as check_* lines. Deterministic values at seed 14: raw factor beta-correlation 0.372 (contamination flagged); residual beta-correlation 0.0 after projection; neutralized mean rank IC 0.037 with t-stat 10.45 vs 7.59 for the contaminated factor — neutralization strictly improves the signal-to-noise of the IC estimate; top-quintile daily turnover 0.181 with signal rank autocorrelation 0.943, consistent with the phi=0.95 signal design; exact deterministic replay of the final observation from a fresh same-seed environment. Cross-seed robustness at {1, 7, 14, 42, 99, 2026}: all nine checks pass in every seed, with the neutralized-beats-raw t-stat margin never below 2.3.
research_corpus.risk_and_backtest_audit: Environment-integrity risks: (a) ordering laundering — an environment that let compute_information_coefficient run on the raw factor would score benchmark exposure as skill; the guard plus the exact-error-string check closes this; (b) neutralization theater — reporting a 'neutralized' factor while computing IC on the raw one; residual_beta_corr is computed from the panel actually used downstream; (c) nondeterminism — fresh randomness per reset would make RLM trajectories unreproducible; the replay check enforces bit-level stability through the rounded observation protocol. Financial caveats surfaced honestly in observations: IC measures ranking skill, not net-of-cost profitability — an IC of 0.037 with 18% daily quintile turnover may not survive realistic costs, which is exactly why evaluate_turnover is a mandatory chain link rather than an optional extra; single-period screening also ignores IC decay horizons and capacity.

adversarial_critique.potential_pitfalls: (1) The seductive mistake this environment forbids: computing IC on the raw factor 'just to get a quick read' — the contaminated t-stat (7.59) is still significant, so a lazy screener would pass the factor WITHOUT discovering that part of its apparent power is beta/sector exposure the portfolio construction will strip out or hedge away. (2) A plan without deliberate ordering mistakes would pass while demonstrating nothing about refusal-and-recovery; the mistakes are load-bearing training signal. (3) Constant exposures make one hat matrix suffice; with time-varying betas the projection must be re-estimated per date, and silently reusing a stale projection is the realistic production bug this simplification hides. (4) Rank ties are measure-zero under continuous simulation but real factors have ties and stale values; double-argsort ranking silently breaks ties by index order there. (5) The turnover metric assumes daily rebalancing of the screened quintile; weekly implementations see different exit rates.
adversarial_critique.falsification_strategy: Break the environment and confirm the battery catches it: (a) remove the IC guard — the guard-count and exact-error-string checks fail; (b) neutralize against an intercept only — residual beta correlation stays ~0.37 and the neutralization check fails; (c) inject fresh randomness per reset — deterministic_replay fails; (d) set IC_STRENGTH to 0 — the neutralized IC collapses toward 0 and the ic-positive check correctly FAILS, proving the battery rejects environments where screening is vacuous; (e) set contamination to 0 — the neutralized-beats-raw margin shrinks toward parity, confirming the t-stat improvement measures exposure removal, not an artifact of the projection.
adversarial_critique.limitations: One scripted plan exercises one recovery path; full RLM coverage needs many plans (shuffled orders, repeated actions, unknown action names) over this environment. Single factor, single period: multi-factor screening with correlation-aware selection, IC decay curves across horizons, and capacity analysis are natural extensions. Neutralization uses OLS residualization against known, constant exposures — real pipelines estimate exposures with error and must decide between regression and optimization-based neutralization. The IC-to-turnover pair is necessary but not sufficient for deployment: transaction-cost-adjusted IC and capacity modeling remain outside this environment's action set.

agent_instructions: 1. Instantiate QuantEnvironment with the fixed seed; never generate data outside it. 2. Drive actions exclusively via env.step({'name': ...}); after each step branch on obs['ok'] — on False, read obs['error'] and re-order the plan to satisfy the stated precondition, never retry blindly. 3. Complete the chain: reset, compute_factor_values, neutralize_exposures, compute_information_coefficient, evaluate_turnover. 4. Log every (action, observation) pair as a json trace line. 5. Run the verification battery: guard count of exactly 2, the IC guard's exact benchmark-contamination error string, full sequence recovery, json round-trip, residual beta exposure ~0, neutralized mean rank IC > 0.01, neutralized t-stat above the raw factor's, turnover in (0, 0.5), deterministic replay against a fresh same-seed environment. 6. Emit verdict=ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED only if every check passes; otherwise name the failing check in ENVIRONMENT_BROKEN. 7. Report IC and turnover exactly as observed and state that cost-adjusted profitability is out of scope for this action set.
